dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「世間の風は冷たいなぁ……」
dialogues.en: "It's a tough world out there."
dialogues.text: "It's a tough world out there."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なんだ急に？」
dialogues.en: "What are you talking about all of a sudden?"
dialogues.text: "What are you talking about all of a sudden?"

dialogues.jp:
テスト期間で人の少ない食堂では、さくらの頭
が目立って仕方が無い――ということで一緒に
食事をしているのだ。
dialogues.en:
Sakura's head stood out when I looked around the dining
hall, half-empty due to exam week. That's why I'm eating
here with her.
dialogues.text:
Sakura's head stood out when I looked around the dining
hall, half-empty due to exam week. That's why I'm eating
here with her.

dialogues.jp: 「ほら、うどんが冷めるぞ」
dialogues.en: "C'mon, your udon noodles will get cold."
dialogues.text: "C'mon, your udon noodles will get cold."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うん……いつまでもクヨクヨしてたってしか
　たねぇや！　頂きます」
dialogues.en: "Hmm... I've got to get over it! I'll eat now!"
dialogues.text: "Hmm... I've got to get over it! I'll eat now!"

dialogues.jp:
割り箸を手に、さくらが鼻に手の甲をあててこ
すりあげる。
dialogues.en:
Holding the disposable chopsticks in her hand, she rubs up
her nose against the back of her hand.
dialogues.text:
Holding the disposable chopsticks in her hand, she rubs up
her nose against the back of her hand.

dialogues.jp: 「美味いか？」
dialogues.en: "Do you like it?"
dialogues.text: "Do you like it?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うん」
dialogues.en: "Yes."
dialogues.text: "Yes."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「それ食ったら自首するんだぞ」
dialogues.en: "After you finish eating, you've got to turn yourself in."
dialogues.text: "After you finish eating, you've got to turn yourself in."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「うにゃ〜、ボクはなんの罪で自首しなきゃい
　けない？」
dialogues.en:
"Ummmm... What kind of crime did I commit, that I have to
turn myself in?"
dialogues.text:
"Ummmm... What kind of crime did I commit, that I have to
turn myself in?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「騒音罪」
dialogues.en: "The crime of noise."
dialogues.text: "The crime of noise."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……あにゅう」
dialogues.en: "Geez..."
dialogues.text: "Geez..."

dialogues.jp:
せっかく箸にかかったうどんを、さくらがまた
肩と一緒に落としてしまう。
dialogues.en:
She drops the udon noodle on her chopsticks at the same time
she sags her shoulders.
dialogues.text:
She drops the udon noodle on her chopsticks at the same time
she sags her shoulders.

dialogues.jp:
「なんだよ。普段なら言い返してくるだろう
　が？」
dialogues.en: "What's going on? No snappy retort as usual?"
dialogues.text: "What's going on? No snappy retort as usual?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ、やっぱりボクってうるさいかなぁ？」
dialogues.en: "Hmm. Am I really that loudmouthed?"
dialogues.text: "Hmm. Am I really that loudmouthed?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「間違いなく静かではないだろうな」
dialogues.en: "You're definitely not a quiet type."
dialogues.text: "You're definitely not a quiet type."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「即答されたよ〜」
dialogues.en: "What a quick response!"
dialogues.text: "What a quick response!"

dialogues.jp:
うどんの中に“の”の字を書きながら、ため息
をつく。
dialogues.en:
She gives a sigh while stirring the soup in a circle with
her chopsticks.
dialogues.text:
She gives a sigh while stirring the soup in a circle with
her chopsticks.

dialogues.jp: 「なんだ、うるさいって言われたのか？」
dialogues.en: "Huh, they told you to be quiet, didn't they?"
dialogues.text: "Huh, they told you to be quiet, didn't they?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「それに近いことだね。講師の人に注意されちっ
　たよ」
dialogues.en: "It's kind of close. The teacher warned me."
dialogues.text: "It's kind of close. The teacher warned me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「まぁ、みんなテストでピリピリしてるから
　なぁ。……うどん一口くれ」
dialogues.en:
"I know everybody is worked up for the exams. Hey, take a
bite!"
dialogues.text:
"I know everybody is worked up for the exams. Hey, take a
bite!"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「そうだね。もう少し新入りらしくしないとね」
dialogues.en: "You're right. I should behave like a newcomer."
dialogues.text: "You're right. I should behave like a newcomer."

dialogues.jp: 椀をさしだしながらさくらが頬杖をつく。
dialogues.en: Pushing her bowl away, Sakura puts her chin in her hand.
dialogues.text: Pushing her bowl away, Sakura puts her chin in her hand.

dialogues.jp:
「必要以上に大人しくする必要はないだろうけ
　ど、そのあたりの配慮は大切だと思うぞ」
dialogues.en:
"You don't need to be super-quiet, but I think it's
important to give extra consideration to your surroundings."
dialogues.text:
"You don't need to be super-quiet, but I think it's
important to give extra consideration to your surroundings."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「渡る世間は義理と人情だからねぇ」
dialogues.en: "You need only love and duty in this world."
dialogues.text: "You need only love and duty in this world."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「ふむ」
dialogues.en: "Hm."
dialogues.text: "Hm."

dialogues.jp: もごもご、とご飯を食べながら呟く。
dialogues.en: I murmur while eating rice.
dialogues.text: I murmur while eating rice.

dialogues.jp:
からかっても反応がないので、あまり面白くな
いな。
dialogues.en:
Even when I tease her, she doesn't react to it, which is no
fun to me.
dialogues.text:
Even when I tease her, she doesn't react to it, which is no
fun to me.

dialogues.jp: 「で、お前はいったいなにをやったんだ？」
dialogues.en: "So, what exactly did you do?"
dialogues.text: "So, what exactly did you do?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「うにゃ？　なにって？」
dialogues.en: "Umm... What do you mean?"
dialogues.text: "Umm... What do you mean?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「騒音罪と聞いてへこむくらいの、なにをした
　んだいったい？」
dialogues.en:
"You're feeling down because he said you were noisy, but
what exactly did you do?"
dialogues.text:
"You're feeling down because he said you were noisy, but
what exactly did you do?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「あのね、テスト中にブツブツと喋りつづけて
　るらしいんだよ」
dialogues.en: "According to him, I kept talking during the exam."
dialogues.text: "According to him, I kept talking during the exam."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「なにを？」
dialogues.en: "What did you talk about?"
dialogues.text: "What did you talk about?"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp:
「問題の答えとか、遊びに行きたい遊びに行き
　たいって……」
dialogues.en:
"He said I talked about the answers for the questions, or I
kept saying 'I want to play, I want to play.'"
dialogues.text:
"He said I talked about the answers for the questions, or I
kept saying 'I want to play, I want to play.'"

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「みんなが遊んでくれないんだよ……」
dialogues.en: "Because nobody wants to play with me."
dialogues.text: "Because nobody wants to play with me."

dialogues.speaker: Sakura
dialogues.jp: 「……そりゃ難儀だな」
dialogues.en: "It's a bummer."
dialogues.text: "It's a bummer."

dialogues.jp:
グズグズとうどんをすするさくらを眺めながら
どうにもならない励ましをすることにした。
dialogues.en: Watching Sakura sup her udon noodles, I try to comfort her.
dialogues.text: Watching Sakura sup her udon noodles, I try to comfort her.

dialogues.jp: 「かったりいなぁ」
dialogues.en: "What a pain."
dialogues.text: "What a pain."

dialogues.jp: ◆おすましさくら２◆
dialogues.en: ◆La-di-da Sakura 2◆
dialogues.text: ◆La-di-da Sakura 2◆

dialogues.jp:
食堂でへこんでいるさくらを見かけた。なんで
も、テスト中に答えを思わず口にしてしまうの
を怒られたらしい。
dialogues.en:
I found Sakura feeling down in the dining hall. She had been
told off for talking about the answers during the exam.
dialogues.text:
I found Sakura feeling down in the dining hall. She had been
told off for talking about the answers during the exam.

dialogues.jp: そりゃそうだ……。
dialogues.en: No wonder.
dialogues.text: No wonder.
